verdict.rationale: Unleash documents strategy variants for A/B and multivariate testing, and impact metrics that gate rollouts on error-rate or latency thresholds. Neither is a statistics engine. Nothing in the evidence describes Bayesian or frequentist analysis of experiment results, significance calculations, or variance-reduction options such as CUPED. Variants handle traffic splitting and impact metrics are rollout safeguards, so both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can trust a documented statistics engine (Bayesian or frequentist, with variance-reduction options) behind experiment results
